test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

If you__ give away__ smoking, your health will improve.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase 'give away' is incorrect in this context.
 
• The correct phrasal verb to use is **'give up'**, which means to quit or stop doing something.
 
• The phrasal verbs **'give off'** and **'give out'** do not fit the context of quitting smoking.
 
 
• **Example:** If you **give up** smoking, your health will improve.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct phrase to be used is 'give up' in place of 'give away'.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: *If you **give up** smoking, your health will improve*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The phrasal verb **'give off'** means to emit or release something.

 
 
• **Example:** *The flowers **give off** a pleasant fragrance*.
 
 
 
• The phrasal verb **'give out'** means to distribute something.
 
 
• **Example:** *The teacher **gave out** the test papers to the students*.
